ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area (approx. 85%) contrasted against high-intensity (white) focal clusters (approx. 15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling and discrete circular blobs distributed across both lobes. Significant concentration of contiguous white pixel clusters observed along the interior lower margins, with the largest geometric cluster located on the lower medial quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 110-degree V-shaped central depression dividing the lobes, with a clearly defined vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing boundary. Notable sharp peaks (valleys) on the distal end of the right lobe and smaller, recurring serrations along the mid-sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Dual sigmoidal curves exhibiting initial concavity relative to the median notch, transitioning to broad convexity towards the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread multi-focal clusters of circular white pixel groups (ranging from 2-15 pixels in diameter) consistent with barnacle scar topography across the entire visible fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, unaligned vertical linear disruptions of the black pigmentation mapping on the lower-central region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation/loss of tissue on the upper-distal trailing edge of the right lobe, and jagged, uneven lobe tips indicating physical wear or historical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density white pigmentation cluster located specifically on the lower corner of the left fluke, differing in density from the right lobe.
